notes.title: Save and Load in middle of chapter
notes.content:
Hi, everyone.

We are updated this game to make you play this game more comfortably!
Now you can select "save and quit" button in pause menu (it appears with esc down). Selecting this, you can restart from the latest checkpoint when you launch this game again.
Now all updates I planned have been applied. Next update will be arcade mode, in which you can play harder situation.

AMay

notes.title: patch 1.3
notes.content:
・You can save EVERYWHERE now
・Deleted 3rd stage from middle.

notes.title: Localized to JA & CH!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing this game!

The game is now available in Japanese and Chinese! Originally, we didn't feel the need to do so because of the small amount of text, but we implemented it to let everyone know more about the game and play it.

As for the future of this game, we will only fix bugs as we find them, but once we can confirm that the number of people who have cleared all the stages of this game has exceeded 10 from the status of obtained achievements, we will implement an arcade mode and related achievements. Enjoy (?)

Arcade Mode: This is a game mode in which you are allowed to fail up to twice in each stage. The third failure will force the player to return to the menu screen.

AMay

PS: Another update goal is to implement save and resume in the middle of chapters. It will take some time...

notes.title: patch 1.2
notes.content:
Localization update
1. Now you can play in Japanese and Chinese.
2. You can see the hook mistake more clearly.
3. Many camera bugs fixed.

notes.title: patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hot fixes
1. Fixed a log leading to the menu that was interfering with play.
2.  The color of objects was wrong in some stages.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Hello, we have finally released our game.

Originally, I was going to finish it as a small game, but I had so much fun designing the levels that before I knew it, it was finished. Games made under smooth sailing are often fun, but this one is a bit more difficult, so I think it's a bit more core gamer oriented.
Many fans of 2D platformers are core players (I have the impression), so I hope you will be pleased with it.

May your letter reach to the destination properly.

AMay
